truth_sources: fpga-design-guide.md s2 (frame geometry and DMA length)
notes: A rule is evaluated only when its input reading exists; missing readings yield BLOCKED, never PASS.
Rules with a when precondition yield NOT_APPLICABLE when the precondition is false.
This file is frozen for T11.runA-bringup-kit; changing it requires a new manifest.
Register access is currently blocked (B1); these rules are for post-recovery use.

rules.name: MAGIC
rules.source: contract registers.json offset 64 (MAGIC, RO); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v:350 and module parameter MAGIC=0x50434946

rules.name: CTRL
rules.source: contract registers.json ctrl_bits bits0..8 (bit4 reserved read0); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v:354,355

rules.name: EXT_MAGIC
rules.source: contract registers.json extension offset 280 reset 826362706 (=0x31414B52); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v:499

rules.name: EXT_VERSION
rules.source: contract registers.json extension offset 284 reset 65536 (=major1.minor0); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v:500

rules.name: DDR_LEN_A
rules.source: fpga-design-guide.md s2 (128 header + 2592000 payload + 640 tail = 2592768); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xAC

rules.name: DDR_BASE_A
rules.source: fpga-design-guide.md s2 (writer-published base is 128B aligned); rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xA4

rules.name: DDR_STATUS_A
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xA8: bit0 valid, bit1 busy, bit2 err, bit3 alive, bit4 cal_done, [31:16] err_cnt

rules.name: PUSH_STATUS
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xC4: bit0 busy, bit1 last_ok, bit2 doorbell_sent, bit3 ddr_alive, bit4 ddr_cal_done, [31:16] err_cnt

rules.name: PUSH_ERR
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xC8: 0 normal, 1 dst unconfigured, 2 tl_tx_wait timeout, 3 AXI non-OKAY, 4 doorbell unconfigured

rules.name: TX_STATUS
rules.source: contract registers.json extension offset 276 bits0..4; rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0x114

rules.name: CAM_DROP_A3
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xF4: 24'd0 + verdict bits0..5 (p_bad, no EOF, word count, beat count, axi_err, pub_ok)

rules.name: PUSH_TLP_CNT
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xCC: normally 2400 MWr per 1080p frame (doorbell excluded)

rules.name: DDR_BASE_A
rules.source: rtl/ep_side/img/ep_bar_win.v header 0xA4: base of the published frame; zero with seq>0 means no frame was published

rules.name: TX_CMD
rules.source: contract registers.json extension offset 264: W1 command, reads 0
